# ui::Scheduler

Header: `winui/core/Scheduler.hpp`.

A pool of worker threads for background work and parallel layout.

Construct one to give a piece of work its own threads, and hand it to `ui::on_background(pool)` or to [`ParallelLayout::scheduler`](../tree/parallel-layout.md). Work on a pool must not touch the UI tree. The [Inline](#struct-inline) mode runs everything synchronously on the calling thread, for deterministic tests. The destructor runs every job still queued, then joins the workers.

Example: 
```cpp
// Two threads of its own, so an index never waits behind other background work.
ui::Scheduler indexers{2};

// `status` is app state that outlives the window, shown by a Text bound to it.
ui::FireAndForget index(ui::Scheduler& indexers, ui::Window& window, ui::Property<std::string>& status,
                        std::filesystem::path folder)
{
    const ui::WindowRef home = window.ref();
    co_await ui::on_background(indexers); // on one of the pool's threads
    const auto files = std::distance(std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator{folder}, {});
    co_await ui::on_ui_thread(home);
    status = std::format("{} files", files);
}
```

## Scheduler

```cpp
Scheduler(std::size_t thread_count = 0)
```

Real worker threads. thread_count == 0 auto-detects: max(1, hardware_concurrency()).

## Scheduler

```cpp
Scheduler(Inline)
```

The deterministic mode (see [Inline](#struct-inline)): no threads.

## ~Scheduler

```cpp
~Scheduler()
```

Runs every job still queued, then joins the worker threads.

## Scheduler

```cpp
Scheduler(const Scheduler&) = delete
```

Not copyable: it owns threads.

## operator=

```cpp
Scheduler& operator=(const Scheduler&) = delete
```

Not copyable: it owns threads.

## thread_count

```cpp
std::size_t thread_count() const
```

Real worker thread count (0 in inline mode).

## worker_count

```cpp
std::size_t worker_count() const
```

How many jobs can run at once: [thread_count()](#thread_count), and 1 in inline mode. Parallel layout splits its measuring into this many chunks.

## struct Inline

Tag selecting the deterministic mode for tests: work runs synchronously, in the order it was queued, on the calling thread, with no worker threads and no interleaving. Construct with `Scheduler{Scheduler::Inline{}}`.
